correctness.rationale: The quantified confluence axioms reduce exactly to four disjoint root-row cases. For each leaf permutation cycle, equivariance of its row representatives yields an independent invariant-subset count: gcd of source and target cycle lengths controls number of free target orbits. Burnside summation proves the formula for every m>=2. Direct exhaustive confluence and four-modal checks, independent canonical orbit enumeration and permutation fixed-count checks pass through m=3; exact-rational formula evaluation passes through m=8. These tests support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete isomorphism-class enumeration for the simplest naturally branching intuitionistic preorder with both modal confluences. The count is not the earlier labelled total: nontrivial automorphisms require an explicit cycle-index analysis, and the exact formula provides canonical symmetry-reduced frame-space sizes at every m. A motivated all-size classification has independent mathematical use for generating nonisomorphic finite countermodel frames.
